scene.note: Page points, top-left origin; the picture is placed turned and draws three plans, one scene each. The crop is the lower-left plan, the place's own map. The grid block is one square of this plan, fitted to its walls at the size measured on the right-hand plan; the distance is ACKS's assumed dungeon square (JJ ch. 8). A key is pinned once a plan, on its first room in reading order.

Page points, top-left origin: the upper-left plan of the picture's three, one more scene of its place (part). The grid block is one square of this plan, fitted to its walls at the size measured on the right-hand plan; the distance is ACKS's assumed dungeon square (JJ ch. 8). A key is pinned once, on its first room in reading order.

Geometry in page points, top-left origin: the right-hand plan of the picture's three, with the shading around it, one more scene of its place (part). The grid block is one drawn square of this plan (measured on the lattice, both axes), and the distance is ACKS's assumed dungeon square (JJ ch. 8). Pins sit on the numbered circles.
